desc: 白底主图开场，含痛点四格、辨识对比、冲泡配伍与质检收口的详情页漏斗
name: 日常冲泡甘润花草茶款

shots.intent: 搜索结果页一眼看清包装形态与干花内容物，拿下首屏点击
一秒给出第一购买理由，用一碗饱满干花把核心主张说清
shots.textZone: one headline line on top, one short sub-line left-aligned beneath it

shots.intent: 用四格日常情境卡让买家对号入座，制造继续下滑阅读的理由
shots.textZone: top headline band, one bottom label on each of the four cards

shots.intent: 用种植地实景与四项风土要点解释品质来路，降低决策风险
shots.textZone: top headline band with a four-icon caption row, one map-pin marker beside the origin scene

shots.intent: 用微距呈现干花表面纤维与花萼结构，证明干燥工艺与原料完整度
同机位同光比的双栏微距，把可辨识特征变成一眼看懂的差别
shots.textZone: top headline band, one bottom label for each of the two columns

shots.intent: 用茶汤表面微距加两格感官卡片，把冲开之后的观感说具体
shots.textZone: top headline band, two cards on the right each carrying one title and two short lines

shots.intent: 把投茶量、水温、焖泡时间三步讲清，让买家想象自己冲一杯
shots.textZone: top headline band, one label for each of the three numbered dots in the middle

shots.intent: 用三行同机位实拍加竖排标签，给买家一套可复述的挑选方法
shots.textZone: top headline band, three stacked one-word labels with one short label line on the right

shots.intent: 给出三种搭配冲法让买家按口味选规格，提高客单与加购
shots.textZone: top headline band, one label beneath each of the three cups

shots.intent: 展示封口结构与独立小包，消除储存与卫生顾虑
shots.textZone: top headline band, three short labels below, pouch detail on the right

shots.intent: 以组合陈列加单一行动按钮收尾，把阅读转成下单
shots.textZone: top headline band, one rounded button centered at the bottom

style.backgroundSystem: packshots on a #FFFFFF seamless sweep, infographic screens on #E8F4EF panels, hero and closing screens on #14615A panels, one outdoor cultivated-field screen for origin
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in #D9A85C, numbered circles, hairline dividers, rounded rectangle cards with 16px corner radius
style.lightingSystem: soft top key from the front-left with a bounce fill, 4300K to 5500K, gentle specular on glass rims, soft contact shadows only, never harsh cast shadows
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium herbal infusion ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of panel #14615A, info panel #E8F4EF, accent line #D9A85C and infusion tone #D9A02E on a #FFFFFF sweep; neutral soft top key from the front-left with bounce fill, 4300K to 5500K, gentle glass specular, soft contact shadows only; modern geometric sans-serif with one text weight per screen; thin single-weight line icons and numbered circles in #D9A85C; rounded cards with 16px corner radius and hairline dividers; loose dried buds shown with real fibre texture, never plastic; stable product angle, scale and centering; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no efficacy iconography.
noDrift: no efficacy iconography such as flames, medical crosses, shields or body diagrams
style.presentationRules: keep the same slight 3/4 20-degree hero angle and the same dish-and-pouch scale across the set; loose dried buds rendered with real fibre and petal texture, never plastic; product always grounded by a contact shadow
style.surfaceSystem: matte linen #F2ECE1, matte board #F6F1E8, matte wood #DCC3A3, shallow dish in #FFFFFF
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; Chinese headline 28-48pt, sub-label 16-20pt, card label 10-16pt, one text weight per screen, copy always set in #14615A or #FFFFFF
